text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Silence Suzuka! Strong, far too strong! 
She claims victory once again!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaah--!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Piling victory upon victory, Silence 
Suzuka is now said to be a presence that 
whips up a whirlwind of fanaticism."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as media appearances and magazine 
features were becoming more frequent—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"That concludes our interview. Thank you 
very much. We'll keep rooting for you!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...Um, it's not a big deal, but there's 
something that's been on my mind.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Why have the number of interviews been 
increasing lately...?"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It's not just the interviews. Recordings, 
photo shoots, and the like... Compared to 
before, somehow...
choice_data_list:
(Could it be that she's not even aware of 
it...?)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Airheaded as she is, she might not even 
realize she's in the middle of a storm.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Showing her would be faster than 
explaining with words. I handed over the 
magazine that had just arrived yesterday.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
? This isn't the magazine you were 
interviewed for, is it?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: No, not yet...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On the cover was a huge headline reading, 
"The Fastest Umamusume Who Charges 
Endlessly Forward." And inside was—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
... "The Charm of Silence Suzuka: As Told 
by Fans"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"『With the way she wins whenever she 
runs, is there any Umamusume who can 
actually defeat her right now?』"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Especially the Tenno Sho (Autumn), it was 
magnificent. It felt just like a dream."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"‘I will definitely come watch her next 
race as well. She is our dream, the very 
definition of brilliance.’"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "Silence Suzuka, thank you so much."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"This is... incredible. It's packed to the 
brim..."
choice_data_list: Everyone is thrilled to see your success.

Everyone is so happy about your 
accomplishments, you know.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: My performance, you say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She counts on her fingers the graded races 
won in succession, led by the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn).

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: N-No way. Already that much……?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um, the truth is, I was so focused on 
running in the lead that I don't really 
remember how many times I've won.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"...My body has felt so light lately, 
running is truly so much fun."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
It feels like I could go on forever and 
ever...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...That's why—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
To think that so many people harbored such 
passionate feelings for my running...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
To think that you were even happier about 
the victory than I was...

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...I'm surprised. And very happy.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I am honored that everyone has entrusted 
their dreams to me.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Let us continue to run together. No matter 
how far. ...Endlessly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For a while after that, Silence Suzuka 
continued reading the magazine article.
